//: Covers src, scripts and test, the same three entries apps/cli declares.
This is the compile-time half of Story 3's 'an unknown verdict never reaches the page':
test/page.test.ts carries a @ts-expect-error on an invented verdict, which reports an
UNUSED directive the moment Verdict widens to accept it. Nothing else typechecks these
files, so an include that dropped test/ would silently disarm that assertion.
